'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Chris Wirfs LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Wirfs]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: She'll handle this. Transcription note: The shields were written on the back of the sheet, which is not in the PDF (the front shield list is a crossed-out DS list marked "Shields on Back"; PDF page 121 is a fragment of a different deck), so the Defensive Shields are left out.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates (V) ''(unconfirmed)''
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
